what: The plan says the auto branch may either reuse wording or factor a shared Apply-all body, but does not require a named shared subsection; current approval-gates.md has the full Apply-all pipeline embedded only in the manual prompt option, and current structure tests only grep for ACTION=EMIT_PLAN, invoke-plan-validator-if-not-quick.sh, and Step 2b.5 anywhere in the file.
scenario_or_breakage: An implementation can add an auto-apply paragraph that copies only “apply every accepted finding” while leaving dedup-sweep, ACTION=EMIT_PLAN, validator dispatch, or Step 2b.5 only in the manual Apply all bullet; existing grep pins still pass because those anchors remain elsewhere, so the new default auto path silently skips required post-apply invariants.
suggested_fix: Revise the plan to mandate a concrete `### Apply-all body (shared)` subsection in approval-gates.md containing the exact ordered pipeline: revise plan, dedup sweep, `dedup-sweep:` breadcrumb, `ACTION=EMIT_PLAN`, full-budget validator invocation, Step 2b.5, then Step 3b. Replace manual option (a) and the auto branch with references to that subsection, and update scripts/test-design-structure.sh to assert the shared-section anchor, both call-site references, and token ordering inside that section.
